design.frozen_inputs: no arm writes world-mind-decision.json, so the world mind's own RNG draw is never bypassed and the prediction signal trains on every tick

findings.status: REPAIRED in S1b -- this record is retained, not deleted, because the first measurement round was recorded under the defect and a reader of that evidence needs to find this note
findings.severity: material -- it invalidated the first (b'') measurement
findings.title: Two of the three masked loss coordinates were identically zero on every tick of a live run
findings.as_found: encodeWorldState derived coordinate 4 (hive count) and coordinate 7 (starvation pressure) from worldState.hives. run-live.js's shared world-state.json had no `hives` key at all -- the hive states live in their own per-hive files -- so both coordinates read 0 on every tick of every live run. The memo anticipated coordinate 4 contributing about zero gradient ("near-constant at 2 in real runs") but expected coordinate 7 to be "the substantive, mirror-orthogonal" target alongside coordinate 6. In practice the effective loss was one-dimensional: total pheromone strength.
findings.repair: the shared world-state WRITER now publishes a `hives` summary -- { count, starvation_pressure } -- computed by world-state.js summarizeHives from the per-hive state run-live.js already holds in memory at write time (no new file reads, no per-hive internals beyond the two aggregates the encoder reads). world-state schema_version 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0, additive. encodeWorldState reads the summary, and still reads the per-hive map shape used by the repair fixture and the checkpoint world payload, with the summary defined so both shapes encode identically.
findings.detection_added: world-mind.js gained (1) a module-load coupling probe that throws if the encoder stops responding to the summary the writer writes, or if the two accepted shapes disagree about the same world, and (2) assessMaskedCoordinateLiveness / assertMaskedCoordinatesLive, a run-level check that a masked coordinate is never zero on every tick. run-live.js records the full encoder output per world tick (`wx` in the decision stream) and prints a liveness line at run end; this harness turns the same report into verdict g_masked_coordinate_liveness. The bug class -- a masked coordinate that is structurally dead while the contract claims it is trained -- is now a failing verdict rather than an inference from a missing key.

run_liveness.standard: every masked coordinate must take a non-zero value on at least one tick of the run; a masked coordinate that is zero on every tick is a dead training dimension, not a small gradient

loss_decomposition.replay_note: the replay reconstructs theta_0 from the root seed and re-applies the recorded (x_t, x_t+1) pairs; matching the committed checkpoint proves the decomposition below describes the run that actually happened

findings.still_not_changed: the loss mask M, the learning rate, and the encoder's feature list are untouched -- changing any of them is a design decision belonging to the memo and the G-LEARNING-SIGNAL-DESIGN gate, and would move training_config_hash. S1b repaired the coupling between the writer and the reader; it did not re-specify the signal.

deviations_from_memo_and_plan.subject: confound-test fail rule (memo section 4.3, plan S2)
deviations_from_memo_and_plan.memo_or_plan_says: binding: median shuffled mirror-p <= unshuffled mirror-p means confounded, and the run fails
deviations_from_memo_and_plan.as_implemented: the literal comparison is computed and reported verbatim as confounded_literal_rule; the BINDING verdict additionally requires that a mirror claim be present at all (unshuffled p < 0.05 and at least 4 distinct build tiles, mirror-detector.js's own thresholds)
deviations_from_memo_and_plan.why: measured, not argued: at root seed 20260806 the FROZEN control -- a mind that by construction never updated a single parameter -- trips the literal rule identically to the learning arm at the same seed (F-rep1 and L-rep1 both show unshuffled p near 0.78 against a median shuffled p near 0.55). A rule that flags a mind which cannot learn is measuring the seed, not the signal. The rule's stated purpose is to adjudicate whether an APPARENT MIRROR is a density artifact; where there is no apparent mirror there is nothing to adjudicate. Letter versus intent: intent preserved, letter reported.
deviations_from_memo_and_plan.surfaced_to: S3 trial and the G-MIND-LEARNING-REVIEW gate -- this is a memo-amendment request, not a silent re-route

deviations_from_memo_and_plan.subject: frozen-mind control mechanism (plan S2 criterion (e))
deviations_from_memo_and_plan.memo_or_plan_says: a frozen-mind control run confirming the delta is the learning path, not incidental drift -- without specifying how the freeze is effected
deviations_from_memo_and_plan.as_implemented: a new run-live.js flag --freeze-world-learning. The world block still encodes, still carries prev_features, and still COMPUTES and reports the masked loss; it simply writes no parameter. Recorded in identity.json as world_learning_frozen, never inferred from silence.
deviations_from_memo_and_plan.why: after S1 there is no longer an un-learning code path to use as a control, so one had to exist. Computing the loss in the frozen arm makes the control strictly more informative: the two arms share every read and differ only in whether the update lands.

deviations_from_memo_and_plan.subject: confound-test permutation seed provenance (plan amendment r2: "shuffle permutation seeded from turn_id")
deviations_from_memo_and_plan.memo_or_plan_says: deterministic permutation seeded from turn_id, seed and permutation recorded
deviations_from_memo_and_plan.as_implemented: turn_id is taken to be the arm's committed generation id (e.g. gen-300-L-rep0), which is the stable per-turn identity the checkpoint lineage already carries. The seed is fnv1a32(turn_id); the seed, the first permutation in full, and a sha256 over all 200 permutations are recorded.
deviations_from_memo_and_plan.why: the plan names turn_id without defining it in this engine. The generation id is the one per-turn identifier that is stable, recorded and reproducible from the evidence alone.

deviations_from_memo_and_plan.subject: deterministic mirror statistic
deviations_from_memo_and_plan.as_implemented: mirror-detector.js's meanNearest/featureCoords/buildCoords are reused unchanged; only its permutationTest is replaced with a seeded equivalent inside this harness
deviations_from_memo_and_plan.why: mirror-detector.js draws its null from Math.random, which cannot carry reproducible evidence. That module is outside this plan's write set and was not modified.

deviations_from_memo_and_plan.subject: the S2 evidence contract gained two verdicts (plan S1b)
deviations_from_memo_and_plan.memo_or_plan_says: S2 lists criteria (a) through (f) plus the reported density guard, the checkpoint-schema contract and RNG parity -- ten verdicts
deviations_from_memo_and_plan.as_implemented: eleven and twelve: g_masked_coordinate_liveness (binding) and loss_decomposition_reported (binding only on the replay reproducing the committed checkpoint). The original ten are unchanged in standard and in threshold.
deviations_from_memo_and_plan.why: S1b requires that dead-zero masked coordinates over a live run become DETECTABLE. A detector that is not a verdict is a comment. The decomposition exists because S1b requires reporting which coordinates carry gradient when the bar is missed, and a decomposition nobody can check against the run that produced it is an assertion -- hence the replay-versus-checkpoint falsifier.

deviations_from_memo_and_plan.subject: decision-stream columns (plan S1b)
deviations_from_memo_and_plan.memo_or_plan_says: nothing about the decision stream beyond what S1 established
deviations_from_memo_and_plan.as_implemented: world rows carry `wx`, the full encoder output for that tick. Cross-round byte comparisons against the FIRST measurement round are therefore invalid; all determinism and round-trip comparisons in this bundle are within-round, arm against arm, which is what they always were.
deviations_from_memo_and_plan.why: the S1b defect was invisible in every aggregate the stream already carried. Recording the training inputs themselves is what makes the liveness verdict a measurement and the loss decomposition a replay rather than a reconstruction.

deviations_from_memo_and_plan.subject: W1 gradient loop bound (memo section 3.3 writes "for k in 0..F-1")
deviations_from_memo_and_plan.memo_or_plan_says: the inner W1 loop runs over F, the encoder feature count
deviations_from_memo_and_plan.as_implemented: the loop runs over W1[j].length, the actual input width
deviations_from_memo_and_plan.why: the two are equal here (input width IS the encoder feature count, 8) so no arithmetic differs; reading the width from the matrix rather than from a constant is the same discipline WORLD_INPUT_SIZE already applies.
